site.sitedescription:
The watershed is less than 20 ha on the crest of the Beartooth Mountains. Underlain by Archean granitic gneiss and drains seasonally into the Clarks Fork of the Yellowstone River.
Mixed sub-alpine parkland dominated by Abies bifolia and Picea engelmannii. The understory and parkland matrix is a mix of Artemisia spp., Vaccinium myrtillus, and a variety of grasses and herbs (Poaceae, Asteraceae and Amaranthaceae).
